date: Jul 13, 2026; event_kind: unknown; Normalized state: Uncertain transition; Event role: Uncertain record (transition unknown); Recorded at: 2026-07-13T07:12:57Z; Historical label: listed under 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' after removal of the 'Considered for Inclusion' heading; Normalization rationale: Commit e338bc94 (PR #11853) removed the 'Considered for Inclusion' heading, leaving the whole CFI list rendered under the 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' heading. The PR body describes its intent as a stage restructuring that adds EIP-8282 and EIP-7610 to Considered for Inclusion, and the same-day correction PR #11917 states the changes 'were not completely correct'. Three days later the ACDE #241 call (2026-07-16) recorded that Glamsterdam EIPs were 'not yet moved to SFI' (ACDbot summary, 00:25:12), confirming no scheduling decision existed on 2026-07-13, so the apparent SFI placement is treated as an editorial error and normalized to unknown rather than scheduled_for_inclusion.; Source: ethereum/EIPs commit e338bc94c99e (Update EIP-7773: Update upgrade stages); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e338bc94c99e69ef86eed3cf6c5f7825073a61b1; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e338bc94c99e69ef86eed3cf6c5f7825073a61b1

date: Jan 20, 2026; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-01-20T21:05:18+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Revival and first full specification pass (PR open for fourteen months). Status Stagnant -> Draft; adds Etan Kissling, Gajinder Singh and Carson as co-authors. Replaces the placeholder 'Parameters / MAGIC: TBD' section with a concrete 'ETH transfer logs' section: the emitting address becomes SYSTEM_ADDRESS 0xfff...ffe (citing EIP-4788), topics[0] becomes keccak256('Transfer(address,address,uint256)') (0xddf252ad...), topics[1]/topics[2] the zero-padded from/to addresses and data the big-endian uint256 amount, explicitly matching the ERC-20 Transfer event. Restricts the SELFDESTRUCT transfer log to SELFDESTRUCT to a different account and adds a new 'Selfdestruct processing' section defining a LOG2-shaped log with topics[0] = keccak256('Selfdestruct(address,uint256)') (0x4bfaba34...) for SELFDESTRUCT to the same account. Rewrites the open questions to ask which magic emitter address to use.; Classification rationale: Turns an under-specified sketch into an implementable log encoding: it fixes the emitter address, the topic hashes, the data encoding and the log arity, and adds an entirely new log kind for self-directed SELFDESTRUCT. Every one of these changes affects client implementation and test generation.; Confidence: high; Commit: e8f1b9a9cd4803e6e84c25a6afce0f980c7c9483; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e8f1b9a9cd4803e6e84c25a6afce0f980c7c9483; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e8f1b9a9cd4803e6e84c25a6afce0f980c7c9483

date: Jan 21, 2026; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-01-21T09:52:30+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds Jared Wasinger as co-author and broadens the LOG2 selfdestruct log into an account closure log: besides SELFDESTRUCT to self it is now also emitted for 'any nonzero-value-holding account closure', placed after all EVM-execution logs but before charging the EIP-1559 priority fee, in lexicographical order of closed account address. topics[1] is redefined from the 'from' address to the closed contract_address, and an explanatory sentence covers the case of a contract already flagged for SELFDESTRUCT that receives further ETH.; Classification rationale: Adds a new emission trigger, a new block-position rule and a new ordering rule, and redefines a topic's meaning; all are directly implementation- and test-visible.; Confidence: high; Commit: b6ddf5a275423a31497411acab623fea3e46bbe2; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b6ddf5a275423a31497411acab623fea3e46bbe2; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b6ddf5a275423a31497411acab623fea3e46bbe2

date: Jan 28, 2026; value: 5; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-01-28T18:05:09+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds the frontmatter field 'requires: 1559, 4788, 6780' and rewrites the two LOG2 bullets. The self-SELFDESTRUCT bullet is narrowed to a contract created in the same transaction; the account-closure bullet is restated as 'each account which has been marked for deletion and holds a balance at the time of removal during transaction finalization'. The emission point is moved from before to AFTER payment of the EIP-1559 priority fee to the coinbase.; Classification rationale: Reverses the ordering of burn logs relative to the coinbase priority-fee payment and narrows the trigger conditions, both of which change the log sequence a client must produce. It also introduces the EIP's first declared cross-EIP requirements.; Confidence: high; Commit: 04026e96ac58077f98a848d0e15ae0e8a599875f; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/04026e96ac58077f98a848d0e15ae0e8a599875f; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/04026e96ac58077f98a848d0e15ae0e8a599875f

date: Feb 13, 2026; value: 6; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-02-14T06:32:21+08:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Renames the EIP to 'ETH transfers and burns emit a log' (title and description), rewrites the Abstract accordingly, renames the 'Selfdestruct processing' section to 'ETH burn logs', and changes the burn log's topics[0] from keccak256('Selfdestruct(address,uint256)') (0x4bfaba34...) to keccak256('Burn(address,uint256)') (0xcc16f5db...). topics[1] is relabelled to a plain 'address', the ordering paragraph is separated from the bullet list and the trailing explanatory sentence is dropped.; Classification rationale: Changes a normative topic hash - the on-chain identifier consumers filter on - and the EIP's declared scope. date: Apr 15, 2026; value: 7; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-04-15T19:43:48+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds 'with non-zero balances' to the burn-log ordering sentence, so lexicographic ordering is stated over the accounts marked for deletion that actually hold a balance.; Classification rationale: Resolves an ambiguity between the bullet list (which already restricts emission to nonzero-balance accounts) and the ordering sentence (which did not), fixing the set over which log order is defined. date: Apr 20, 2026; value: 8; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-04-21T00:04:31+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a fourth transfer-log trigger: 'any nonzero-value-transferring CREATE or CREATE2 to the created account, at the time that the value transfer executes'.; Classification rationale: Adds a new class of emitting operation (contract-creation endowments), expanding the set of logs a client must produce.; Confidence: high; Commit: 1e2f3319997b1725e05f69dfc438db59a666b86d; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/1e2f3319997b1725e05f69dfc438db59a666b86d; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/1e2f3319997b1725e05f69dfc438db59a666b86d

date: May 03, 2026; value: 9; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-05-03T23:54:47+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Records the Soldogn interop breakout decisions. Replaces the three 'Open questions' with settled Rationale prose: SYSTEM_ADDRESS is confirmed as the emitter for consistency with EIP-4788 and to distinguish protocol logs from contract logs; priority-fee and base-fee logs are rejected (log-volume cost, already derivable from header and receipt); withdrawal logs are rejected (no natural emission point, already derivable) and clients MAY instead expose an aggregating RPC. Replaces the 'TODO' Test Cases section with a ten-item test list and a link to the execution-specs suite eip7708_eth_transfer_logs pinned at tree 155c3e136d81dcd5c61086c9d832595b7641db4a. Also changes 'non-zero' to 'nonzero' in the ordering sentence.; Classification rationale: Closes the three outstanding design questions that determined the EIP's scope (which value flows emit logs) and defines the required test surface, including fork-transition behaviour. Both are inputs to implementation and testing even though no existing normative rule is reworded.; Confidence: high; Commit: 100615c2c6f34b6105d3de22a1f3390ff3e1e232; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/100615c2c6f34b6105d3de22a1f3390ff3e1e232; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/100615c2c6f34b6105d3de22a1f3390ff3e1e232

date: May 16, 2026; value: 10; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-05-17T04:59:25+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Simplifies the EIP by delegating the burn case to EIP-8246. Reverts the title and description to 'ETH transfers emit a log' and the Abstract to 'All ETH transfers emit a log'; adds 8246 to 'requires'; deletes the entire 'ETH burn logs' section (the LOG2 Burn event, its topic hash, its two triggers and its ordering rule); replaces 'No backward compatibility issues found' with a Backwards Compatibility subsection stating that after EIP-8246 ETH can no longer be burned via SELFDESTRUCT to self or by sending ETH to an account marked for selfdestruction, so the edge case is not specified here; and removes the two burn-log test cases.; Classification rationale: Removes an entire normative log kind from the EIP and makes the remaining specification conditional on another proposal. This is the largest scope reduction in the file's history and directly changes what clients must implement.; Confidence: high; Commit: 4c64c876efe01ab44aa92d2de961b20d3ffa06da; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4c64c876efe01ab44aa92d2de961b20d3ffa06da; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4c64c876efe01ab44aa92d2de961b20d3ffa06da

date: Jun 09, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-06-09T16:45:46+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Revival and complete rewrite, 193 lines down to 88. Status Stagnant -> Draft; title becomes 'Block Gas Limit Accounting without Refunds' and the description 'Prevent Block Gas Limit Circumvention by Excluding Refunds from Block Gas Accounting'; Toni Wahrstaetter is added as co-author. The scope narrows from 'certain gas discounts and refunds' to refunds alone (specifically SSTORE-to-zero), with warm-access and revert-to-original discounts explicitly retained in block accounting. The specification is restated as two rules - user gas cost stays tx.gas_used = gas_used - gas_refund, and block gas accounting becomes block.gas_used += gas_used with refunds not subtracted - plus a Block Gas Limit Enforcement section. The whole EIP-7623/EIP-4844 data-availability framing, the combined calldata-floor formula, the Implementation section and the DA-heavy test cases are removed; the document is reorganised into standard EIP sections with new Rationale, Backwards Compatibility, Test Cases and Security Considerations.; Classification rationale: Rewrites every normative statement in the EIP, narrows what is excluded from block gas accounting, and removes the coupling to EIP-7623 that the original specification was built on. The resulting rule is what later revisions refine.; Confidence: high; Commit: b18c23c9f03f53f20903fa9f537694862ac987e8; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b18c23c9f03f53f20903fa9f537694862ac987e8; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b18c23c9f03f53f20903fa9f537694862ac987e8

date: Dec 04, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-12-04T23:21:25+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a note to the user gas-cost rule: because receipts store the post-refund gas_used value, validating block gas limits from receipts requires tracking refunds during transaction execution and adding them back to each transaction's gas_used when computing cumulative block gas usage.; Classification rationale: First statement of how the new block accounting interacts with the existing receipt encoding. It tells implementers that receipts alone are insufficient for block gas-limit validation, which is directly implementation- and test-relevant even though no rule is restated.; Confidence: high; Commit: 3a8ab8c6bc1a4df8f413d198005e2a1b09577621; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/3a8ab8c6bc1a4df8f413d198005e2a1b09577621; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/3a8ab8c6bc1a4df8f413d198005e2a1b09577621

date: Jan 16, 2026; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-01-16T06:34:39+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Brings the EIP-7623 calldata floor back into both accounting formulas. Section 1 is retitled 'User and Receipt Gas Accounting (Unchanged)' and its rule becomes gas_used = max(tx_gas_used - gas_refund, calldata_floor_gas_cost); the block rule becomes block.gas_used += max(tx_gas_used, calldata_floor_gas_cost), explicitly citing the calldata floor from EIP-7623 (./eip-7623.md). The receipt note added by the previous revision and the separate 'Block Gas Limit Enforcement' section are deleted.; Classification rationale: Changes both normative formulas by introducing a max() against the calldata floor, which alters the gas charged for calldata-heavy transactions at both levels, and reintroduces an explicit dependency on EIP-7623.; Confidence: high; Commit: 5903a619bf35ac3f6519cb85622667be1c9f16a5; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5903a619bf35ac3f6519cb85622667be1c9f16a5; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5903a619bf35ac3f6519cb85622667be1c9f16a5

date: Jan 19, 2026; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-01-20T00:30:45+08:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a 'Receipt Changes' rule: cumulative_gas_used now carries gas before refunds so it matches block gas accounting, and a NEW receipt field gas_spent carries the post-refund gas the user pays. The 'User and Receipt Gas Accounting (Unchanged)' item is deleted, block accounting becomes item 1, Backwards Compatibility is rewritten to announce the receipt structure change, and test case 3 becomes 'Receipt Fields'.; Classification rationale: Changes the receipt data structure - a consensus-relevant, RPC-visible object - by redefining an existing field's semantics and adding a new one. This is the widest blast radius any revision of this EIP reached.; Confidence: high; Commit: af1a46dfb4b24fb4bc62b8a13a22621ddedd5513; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/af1a46dfb4b24fb4bc62b8a13a22621ddedd5513; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/af1a46dfb4b24fb4bc62b8a13a22621ddedd5513

path.aria-label: date: Jan 07, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-01-07T16:47:24+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Moves slot computation from the execution layer to the consensus layer and adds the plumbing for it. A new 'RPC changes' section states that the slot number is calculated in the consensus layer and passed to the execution layer through the engine API, adds a slot_number uint64 parameter to engine_newPayload, extends the engine API PayloadAttributes object with a slot_number uint64 field, and lets consensus clients optionally expose eth_getSlotNumberFromTimestamp and eth_getTimestampFromSlotNumber. Adds the 'Calculation in consensus layer' rationale and rewrites the Motivation and the encrypted-mempool sub-section as an example application; description becomes 'Precompile to get the current slot number'.; Classification rationale: Introduces new cross-layer interface surface (engine API parameter and PayloadAttributes field, plus two optional JSON-RPC methods) that clients must implement, so the change is substantive and interface-shaped.; Confidence: high; Commit: 7f01d7b262fd2acda7ccb9a7b02aa1914d42e649; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/7f01d7b262fd2acda7ccb9a7b02aa1914d42e649; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/7f01d7b262fd2acda7ccb9a7b02aa1914d42e649

date: Jan 27, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-01-27T11:51:20+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Replaces the 'newPayload change' sub-section with a 'Header extension': instead of an engine_newPayload parameter, the execution block header encoding is extended with a slot_number uint64 field. Adds a 'ZK-VM proving' rationale arguing that SLOT does not increase proving complexity because the slot number now lives in the header, keeping the block self-contained for proving.; Classification rationale: Relocating the slot number from an engine API parameter into the block header changes the block data structure, block hashing and header validation for every client, so this is a substantive interface change despite being an eight-line diff.; Confidence: high; Commit: b9726100a21e8547d9e72b0c9cfae21f860e1fdc; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b9726100a21e8547d9e72b0c9cfae21f860e1fdc; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b9726100a21e8547d9e72b0c9cfae21f860e1fdc

date: Feb 13, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-02-13T18:38:11+08:00; Change type: editorial; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Single-line wording fix in the Specification: 'SLOT returns as output the current slot number as an 8 byte ulong in big endian encoding' becomes '... as an 8-byte uint64 in big-endian encoding'.; Classification rationale: Renames the width in standard EVM/SSZ terminology and hyphenates two compounds. An 8 byte ulong and an 8-byte uint64 are the same value, so no implementation-visible detail changes.; Confidence: high; Commit: 270874f063cf030c04141cac4dff57aabd3b1260; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/270874f063cf030c04141cac4dff57aabd3b1260; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/270874f063cf030c04141cac4dff57aabd3b1260

date: May 20, 2025; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-05-20T16:23:34+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Converts the proposal from a precompile to an opcode and gives it a concrete encoding: title becomes 'SLOTNUM opcode', description 'Opcode to get the current slot number', discussions-to moves to the slotnum-opcode topic, and the Specification now reads 'A new opcode SLOTNUM is introduced at 0x4b. It shall return one stack element', with an Output stack table and 'SlotNumber is an 8 byte uint in big endian encoding'; the fixed gas cost of 2 is retained. The Motivation is rewritten around two existing ways to obtain the slot number on chain - computing it from the block timestamp, or supplying it as calldata and proving it against the beacon block root using EIP-4788 - and the two optional JSON-RPC conversion endpoints and the 'Precompile' rationale sub-section are deleted.; Classification rationale: Changes the instruction form (precompile to opcode), assigns the opcode byte 0x4b, replaces the return-data encoding with a stack result, and removes previously specified optional RPC surface. This is the largest normative change in the file's history and is also the commit that first names another EIP.; Confidence: high; Commit: 0aefdc9d5a4b637ca280832f5fe617a5f4dd4f3f; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0aefdc9d5a4b637ca280832f5fe617a5f4dd4f3f; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0aefdc9d5a4b637ca280832f5fe617a5f4dd4f3f

date: Jun 09, 2025; value: 3; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-06-09T16:48:46+08:00; Change type: editorial; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Frontmatter status Draft -> Review, and the Output sub-section's stack table (a 'Stack' heading plus a two-column table giving top - 0 = SlotNumber, followed by 'SlotNumber is an 8 byte uint in big endian encoding') is collapsed into one prose sentence: 'One element SlotNumber is added to the stack; it is equal to the corresponding slot number for this block. SlotNumber is a uint64 in big endian encoding.'; Classification rationale: Process-status metadata plus a presentation change that restates the same single stack output in prose. path.aria-label: date: Sep 03, 2025; value: 0; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-09-03T08:10:21+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Retitles the EIP from 'Further increase calldata cost' to 'Increase calldata floor cost' (description reworded to match) and re-bases the Rationale's block-size arithmetic on a 45M rather than a 30M gas limit: the EIP-7623 worst case becomes ~1.07 MB and this EIP's worst case ~0.72 MB, and the bullet 'Maximum data-heavy payload size drops to ~0.47 MB' becomes 'drops by ~33%'. date: Feb 15, 2026; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-02-15T22:52:28+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Re-targets the EIP from a 15/60 floor to a flat 64 gas per calldata byte. TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN changes from 15 to 16 and a new quantity floor_tokens_in_calldata = (zero_bytes_in_calldata + nonzero_bytes_in_calldata) * 4 is introduced; the floor branch of the tx.gasUsed max() and the transaction-validity threshold both switch from tokens_in_calldata to floor_tokens_in_calldata, which removes the 1:4 zero/non-zero asymmetry inherited from EIP-7623. Description, Abstract, Motivation (a 10 MiB payload would need ~671M gas rather than ~105M), Rationale (~0.67 MB worst case at 45M gas, ~37% reduction), the wallet guidance (parameter value 16) and the Test Cases are all updated to match.; Classification rationale: Changes the normative pricing parameter and the calldata-tokenisation used by the floor, so every implementation and every test vector for this EIP changes. The largest substantive revision in the file's history.; Confidence: high; Commit: 137a1323c80fd69f87b39183e13efea2f9904ecd; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/137a1323c80fd69f87b39183e13efea2f9904ecd; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/137a1323c80fd69f87b39183e13efea2f9904ecd

date: Apr 15, 2026; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-04-15T13:59:42+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds one sentence to the Specification: 'Equivalently, the floor cost is 64 gas per calldata byte (both zero and non-zero), since TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN * 4 = 64. The token abstraction is retained only for consistency with EIP-7623.'; Classification rationale: Classified substantive because it resolves the mismatch between the EIP's title/description ('64/64 gas per byte') and the specified parameter value (16 per token) that implementers and test authors must program; the rubric treats a material clarification of a parameter as substantive. path.aria-label: date: Aug 21, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-08-21T14:36:01+00:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Replaces the single per-byte charge with a zero/non-zero split: ACCESS_LIST_DATA_COST_PER_BYTE = 16 is removed and ACCESS_LIST_NONZERO_BYTE_COST = 40 and ACCESS_LIST_ZERO_BYTE_COST = 10 are introduced, counted over the serialized access list data. Effective costs rise to ~3200 gas per address and ~3180 gas per storage key; the block-size analysis (478 KB -> 362 KB) and all three test cases are recomputed.; Classification rationale: More than doubles the data surcharge and changes its shape from uniform per-byte to zero/non-zero weighted, which changes the gas charged for every access-list-bearing transaction.; Confidence: high; Commit: 2fbffe5f4d590876fba00489a597e2a0ef675a5b; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2fbffe5f4d590876fba00489a597e2a0ef675a5b; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2fbffe5f4d590876fba00489a597e2a0ef675a5b

date: Aug 24, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-08-24T10:46:57+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Pins down what is counted - 'the addresses (20 bytes each) and storage keys (32 bytes each) contained within the access list' replaces 'the serialized access list data' - and adds a Reference Implementation section giving EELS Python: a count_access_list_bytes helper and the calculate_intrinsic_cost integration that adds access_list_data_cost to the intrinsic gas for AccessList, FeeMarket, Blob and SetCode transactions. Also removes a stray blank line.; Classification rationale: Removes a real ambiguity: 'serialized access list data' could have been read as including RLP framing, whereas the new wording and the reference implementation count exactly 20 bytes per address and 32 bytes per key. The reference implementation also fixes which transaction types are affected and where in the intrinsic-cost calculation the charge lands.; Confidence: high; Commit: acc2533ec925d0659d2001d64edc3e6466e62400; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/acc2533ec925d0659d2001d64edc3e6466e62400; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/acc2533ec925d0659d2001d64edc3e6466e62400

date: Sep 04, 2025; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-09-04T12:47:19+00:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Re-parameterises the surcharge in terms of the EIP-7623 token abstraction. The two EIP-owned constants ACCESS_LIST_NONZERO_BYTE_COST and ACCESS_LIST_ZERO_BYTE_COST are replaced in the parameter table by TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN = 10, sourced from EIP-7623, and the formula becomes access_list_tokens = nonzero * 4 + zero followed by access_list_data_cost = access_list_tokens * TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN. Description, Abstract and Motivation are rewritten (adding the '~21% worst-case block size reduction' claim and the 'contributing to EVM gas while still leaving a non-negligible data footprint' framing); 'Maximum Block Size Impact' is renamed 'Access List Size Impact' and recomputed at a 60M gas limit (1012 KB -> 604 KB); a new 'Maximum Block Size Impact' section states the Snappy-compressed maximum falls from 2.71 MiB to 2.13 MiB. The description acquires the typo 'footpring'.; Classification rationale: The effective rates are numerically unchanged (4 tokens * 10 = 40 gas per non-zero byte, 1 token * 10 = 10 gas per zero byte), but the EIP stops owning its pricing constants and instead derives them from another EIP's TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN. That makes the charge track future changes to EIP-7623 - as the next two revisions demonstrate - so it is a substantive change to the specification even though no gas value moves in this commit.; Confidence: high; Commit: 5aea12c20ee27b3d85f7c2ec9e6a09e451fd81f0; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5aea12c20ee27b3d85f7c2ec9e6a09e451fd81f0; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5aea12c20ee27b3d85f7c2ec9e6a09e451fd81f0

date: Jan 20, 2026; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-01-20T11:36:27+00:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Retargets the floor constant from EIP-7623 to EIP-7976: 'requires' becomes 2930, 7976 and TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN becomes 15 (sourced from EIP-7976) instead of 10, raising the surcharge to 60 gas per non-zero byte and 15 per zero byte (~3600 gas per address, ~3820 per storage key). The Motivation's floor-pricing reference switches to EIP-7976, all worked numbers and the reference-implementation constants are recomputed, and the compressed-block-size claim moves from 2.13 MiB to approximately 1.7 MiB. The title is capitalised to 'Increase Access List Cost' and the description typo 'footpring' is corrected to 'Price access lists for data to reduce maximum block size'.; Classification rationale: A 50 per cent increase in the data surcharge, driven by adopting a different EIP's floor constant. Both the gas values and the declared dependency change.; Confidence: high; Commit: 0fdeb4ce5d592907b12532dc9aa0da62899d786d; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0fdeb4ce5d592907b12532dc9aa0da62899d786d; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0fdeb4ce5d592907b12532dc9aa0da62899d786d

date: Jan 21, 2026; value: 5; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-01-21T17:40:01+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Restructures the EIP from a standalone surcharge into a modification of the EIP-7623 floor itself. 'requires' becomes 2930, 7623 and TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN returns to 10 sourced from EIP-7623 (Motivation reference reverted too). Access list tokens are now added to access_list_cost AND folded into the floor: total_data_tokens = tokens_in_calldata + tokens_in_access_list, data_floor_gas_cost = TX_BASE_COST + TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN * total_data_tokens. A full tx.gasUsed formula with the max() of execution-side and floor-side costs is given, plus a new validity rule: a transaction with a gas limit below 21000 + TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN * total_data_tokens, or below its intrinsic gas cost, is invalid. The Rationale is replaced, ALL THREE test cases are deleted, the reference implementation is rewritten around calculate_access_list_tokens and a combined intrinsic/floor return, and Security Considerations is rewritten.; Classification rationale: Changes what the EIP does: access list data now participates in the transaction floor calculation rather than only being surcharged, and a new transaction-validity condition is introduced. This changes gas outcomes for transactions whose execution cost sits below the floor, and adds a new invalidity case clients must enforce.; Confidence: high; Commit: 1356811a1522f1be9df1a2a600f2ac7a750cf7ba; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/1356811a1522f1be9df1a2a600f2ac7a750cf7ba; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/1356811a1522f1be9df1a2a600f2ac7a750cf7ba

date: Mar 27, 2026; value: 6; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-03-27T20:15:07+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Aligns with EIP-7976's updated calldata floor. 'requires' becomes 2930, 7623, 7976 and TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN becomes 16, sourced from EIP-7976. The zero/non-zero weighting is dropped from the floor: floor_tokens_in_access_list = access_list_bytes * 4 and floor_tokens_in_calldata = (zero_bytes + nonzero_bytes) * 4, so every byte now counts as four tokens regardless of value; total_data_tokens is renamed total_floor_data_tokens throughout, including in the validity rule. The reference implementation is rewritten to sum byte lengths instead of inspecting byte values.; Classification rationale: Both the constant (10 -> 16) and the tokenisation rule change: a zero byte in an access list goes from 1 token to 4 tokens, so the surcharge rises from 10 to 64 gas per zero byte and from 40 to 64 gas per non-zero byte. Implementations and tests must change.; Confidence: high; Commit: 87def23e7d59b4c01a28744a23c42edde0c97938; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/87def23e7d59b4c01a28744a23c42edde0c97938; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/87def23e7d59b4c01a28744a23c42edde0c97938

date: May 05, 2026; value: 7; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-05-05T17:16:00+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Simplifies the specification back to a flat surcharge (contributed by Pawel Bylica). The access list floor-token machinery is deleted: access_list_data_cost = 64 * access_list_bytes (1280 per address, 2048 per storage key), stated to match the EIP-7976 calldata floor rate, and this surcharge is added to tx.gasUsed OUTSIDE the max(), leaving the EIP-2930 access_list_cost and the EIP-7976 floor calculation untouched - the floor term reverts to TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN * floor_tokens_in_calldata. The validity rule becomes 'any transaction with a gas limit below tx.gasUsed evaluated with execution_gas_used = 0 is invalid'.; Classification rationale: Reverses the structural change made on 2026-01-21: access list data no longer enters the floor calculation and is charged unconditionally instead. date: May 07, 2026; value: 8; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-05-07T09:28:59+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Brings the reference implementation into line with the flat-surcharge specification: calculate_access_list_floor_tokens becomes calculate_access_list_data_cost returning total_bytes * 64, the surcharge is kept separate from the EIP-2930 access_list_cost, and it is added to BOTH the returned intrinsic_gas and the returned floor_gas. The docstring now states the intended identity tx.gasUsed = max(intrinsic_gas + execution_gas_used, floor_gas).; Classification rationale: The preceding commit changed the prose but left a reference implementation that still folded access list tokens into the floor, so the document was internally inconsistent for two days. Grouped with the flat-surcharge rework it completes. This is the last substantive revision at the pinned state.; Confidence: high; Commit: ff38d6d99bc34721d33b77d79dd3ab4b86079cb7; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ff38d6d99bc34721d33b77d79dd3ab4b86079cb7; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ff38d6d99bc34721d33b77d79dd3ab4b86079cb7

path.aria-label: date: Aug 30, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-08-30T23:11:58+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Rewrites the Abstract and two Motivation paragraphs, and - the substantive part - adds a prose normative specification of the factory's behaviour ahead of the bytecode: when called, the account invokes CREATE2 (linking EIP-1014) with salt = first 32 bytes of input, init code = the remaining input and value = the call's value; the call reverts with empty return data if input is shorter than 32 bytes; if CREATE2 outputs 0 the call reverts with the creation frame's return data. The bytecode is retained and is now described as implementing that specification.; Classification rationale: Before this commit the only normative statement of behaviour was the opaque hex blob plus an assembly listing. Stating the interface and the two failure modes in prose is what clients and test authors implement against, and it is the first appearance of the EIP-1014 body reference.; Confidence: high; Commit: 85d76ebe7795c478efecc119054744ac492709e9; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/85d76ebe7795c478efecc119054744ac492709e9; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/85d76ebe7795c478efecc119054744ac492709e9

The Specification already called the first 32 bytes a salt, so no normative rule changes and no implementation could have differed.; Confidence: high; Commit: a9ca3432e0541a23f17d18c8c22cdaa2dabbb014; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/a9ca3432e0541a23f17d18c8c22cdaa2dabbb014; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/a9ca3432e0541a23f17d18c8c22cdaa2dabbb014

date: Nov 05, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-11-05T22:05:32+00:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Changes the single parameter FACTORY_ADDRESS from 0x0B to 0x12 (and the matching Rationale text, now 'the next lowest address after currently accepted precompiles'), and adds a Backwards Compatibility section requiring that FACTORY_ADDRESS not be used by other precompiles or predeploys on a chain, with the constant chosen to minimise that risk.; Classification rationale: Changes the address at which every deterministic deployment resolves - the EIP's defining constant - and adds a new compatibility requirement on chains adopting it.; Confidence: high; Commit: ec05b85e530a7ea97ea52a1f0312d88eb0eb1be2; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ec05b85e530a7ea97ea52a1f0312d88eb0eb1be2; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ec05b85e530a7ea97ea52a1f0312d88eb0eb1be2

date: Jun 09, 2026; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-06-09T20:01:38+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Complete redesign: the EIP stops specifying a new predeploy and instead formalises the already-deployed 'Arachnid' keyless factory. Title becomes 'Deterministic Factory Contract'; Toni Wahrstaetter and Nick Johnson are added as co-authors; 'requires' drops 211 and keeps 1014. FACTORY_ADDRESS becomes 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C and the runtime code becomes 0x7fffffff...6014600cf3. The requirement is restated as 'the chain's state MUST include FACTORY_ADDRESS with nonce 1 and this runtime code', satisfiable by an ordinary (including keyless) transaction, by genesis inclusion, or by an irregular state transition. Behaviour differences from the previous factory are spelled out: an input shorter than 32 bytes causes an attempted ~2^256-byte calldatacopy and reverts as a result; a failed creation reverts with EMPTY return data rather than propagating the creation frame's data; the created address is returned as exactly 20 unpadded bytes. Motivation is condensed and re-argued around keyless transactions becoming undeployable as gas schedules change. The whole previous Rationale is replaced by a 'Choice of factory' section (about 25000 mainnet uses, hundreds of chains, EIP-1014 compatibility, no PUSH0 dependency per EIP-3855, and the two accepted downsides). Backwards Compatibility becomes 'no issues; a no-op on chains that already have it'. The Test Cases section is deleted and a Yul-equivalent listing replaces the assembly listing.; Classification rationale: Replaces the specified contract, its address, its bytecode, its revert and return-data semantics, and the mechanism by which a chain satisfies the EIP. Nothing normative survives from the previous specification; this is the single largest change in the file's history.; Confidence: high; Commit: a0a7f5adb491fc6ad4b008f307899c30f348db22; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/a0a7f5adb491fc6ad4b008f307899c30f348db22; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/a0a7f5adb491fc6ad4b008f307899c30f348db22

date: Jul 02, 2026; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-07-02T13:27:44+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Removes the nonce from the state requirement: 'MUST include FACTORY_ADDRESS with nonce 1 and this runtime code' becomes 'MUST include FACTORY_ADDRESS with this runtime code', and the closing sentence drops 'MUST have the nonce and runtime code' in favour of 'MUST have the runtime code specified above. If deployed using an irregular state transition, the nonce SHOULD be set to 1.'; Classification rationale: Downgrades a MUST on account nonce to a conditional SHOULD, changing what a conforming chain state and any state test must assert.; Confidence: high; Commit: 0b59e164e21764ffdc5bca33ee0cf191e73b6002; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0b59e164e21764ffdc5bca33ee0cf191e73b6002; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0b59e164e21764ffdc5bca33ee0cf191e73b6002

path.aria-label: date: Nov 04, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-11-04T03:54:51+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Shifts the EXCHANGE operand encoding down by one so the assembly operands match the intended SWAP-like indexing. decode_pair returns (q + 1, r + 1) / (r + 1, 29 - q) instead of (q + 2, r + 2) / (r + 2, 30 - q), and encode_pair's assertion and arithmetic change from '2 <= n <= 14 and n < m <= 30 and n + m <= 32' with the m <= 17 branch to '1 <= n <= 13 and n < m <= 29 and n + m <= 30' with the m <= 16 branch. A Rationale paragraph is added explaining that the operands look off by one because EXCHANGE n m operates on stack depths n + 1 and m + 1, chosen so that EXCHANGE n m is equivalent to SWAP{n} SWAP{m} SWAP{n}. Two disassembly test cases are renumbered accordingly (e812 becomes EXCHANGE 2 3, e8d0 becomes EXCHANGE 1 19).; Classification rationale: Changes the immediate-to-operand mapping of a new instruction, so every assembler, disassembler and EVM implementation of EXCHANGE, and its test vectors, change with it.; Confidence: high; Commit: db5c483ea122c6735cd92ff135de985f0e9253e2; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/db5c483ea122c6735cd92ff135de985f0e9253e2; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/db5c483ea122c6735cd92ff135de985f0e9253e2

date: Dec 11, 2025; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-12-11T01:20:09+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Replaces 'revert, consuming all gas' with 'halt with exceptional failure' in the invalid-immediate step of all three instructions, and adds an explicit stack-underflow check to each: DUPN halts if n > len(stack), SWAPN if n + 1 > len(stack), EXCHANGE if m + 1 > len(stack). (The inserted checks and the following steps are both numbered 5 in the resulting lists.); Classification rationale: Fixes the failure mode in EVM terms and specifies underflow behaviour that the creation version left unstated, both of which implementations and consensus tests must match.; Confidence: high; Commit: dcbc74e19eb66678144dcc43ec40d1ac660843d6; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/dcbc74e19eb66678144dcc43ec40d1ac660843d6; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/dcbc74e19eb66678144dcc43ec40d1ac660843d6

date: Feb 07, 2026; value: 6; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-02-07T01:32:09+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Rewrites the 'Disallowed immediate range' rationale. The new text first states the EVM property being preserved (it is not possible to jump into the middle of an instruction, which PUSH immediates uphold by being masked from JUMPDEST analysis), then explains that these instructions preserve it without changing JUMPDEST analysis by forbidding 0x5b and 0x60-0x7f in their immediates, then gives the masked-opcode alternative and why it would break backwards compatibility without bytecode versioning (EOF), and finally notes that the encoding can be reused by future immediate-carrying instructions. 'counterfactual deployments-in-waiting' becomes 'included in transactions yet to be published on chain'. The sentence saying it would be safe to allow 0x5c to 0x5f is deleted.; Classification rationale: Confined to the Rationale section. The disallowed immediate ranges, the instruction algorithms, the encode/decode functions and every test vector are unchanged, so nothing an implementer or test author consumes moves.; Confidence: high; Commit: 05146bfcf2a3b0b5962b289ab2bd79b706a45906; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/05146bfcf2a3b0b5962b289ab2bd79b706a45906; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/05146bfcf2a3b0b5962b289ab2bd79b706a45906

date: Feb 25, 2026; value: 7; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-02-25T21:39:44+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Re-encodes all three immediates branchlessly and widens EXCHANGE. decode_single becomes (x + 145) % 256 and encode_single (n + 111) % 256, replacing the two-branch +17 / -20 form; decode_pair replaces 'k = x if x <= 79 else x - 48' with 'k = x ^ 143' and encode_pair returns 'k ^ 143'. EXCHANGE's invalid immediate range widens from 79 < x < 128 to 81 < x < 128 (so 0x50 and 0x51 become valid), decode_pair's assertion admits x <= 81 and encode_pair's admits n <= 14. Every assembly and execution test vector is re-encoded to the new immediates (for example DUPN 17 is now e680 rather than e600, EXCHANGE 2 3 is e89d rather than e812), e850 changes from INVALID_EXCHANGE, POP to EXCHANGE 14 16, and e851 / e852 are added.; Classification rationale: Changes the byte-level encoding of every immediate for all three instructions and the set of valid EXCHANGE operand pairs. The most disruptive revision after creation: all previously published bytecode examples and test vectors become invalid.; Confidence: high; Commit: d0b75a60e8b8cd79048a439c78fb3b3d1c3c9adb; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d0b75a60e8b8cd79048a439c78fb3b3d1c3c9adb; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d0b75a60e8b8cd79048a439c78fb3b3d1c3c9adb

path.aria-label: date: Oct 22, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-10-22T14:28:38+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Defines success-vs-failure gas accounting for contract deployment: GAS_NEW_ACCOUNT, GAS_CODE_DEPOSIT*L and HASH_COST(L) are charged only on the success path, with explicit total-gas formulas and check ordering; removes the duplicated-code deposit-exemption sentence from the abstract; reformats the parameter table.; Classification rationale: Materially specifies when deployment charges apply, replacing the previous duplication-check design.; Confidence: high; Commit: 4e9dba1082fbd729d3d8f66d8538f14f7e3a363a; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4e9dba1082fbd729d3d8f66d8538f14f7e3a363a; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4e9dba1082fbd729d3d8f66d8538f14f7e3a363a

date: Oct 28, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-10-28T10:20:33+00:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Changes GAS_NEW_ACCOUNT's affected operations to CALL*, removes GAS_SELF_DESTRUCT_NEW_ACCOUNT (replaced by GAS_NEW_ACCOUNT), and corrects the deployment cost example accordingly.; Classification rationale: Changes the parameter schedule's scope and removes a distinct constant.; Confidence: high; Commit: dee539a58f206ce2a3bf08130605adf50938c40f; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/dee539a58f206ce2a3bf08130605adf50938c40f; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/dee539a58f206ce2a3bf08130605adf50938c40f

date: Jan 06, 2026; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-01-06T15:43:38+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Major rework (empty commit subject): cost-per-state-byte becomes a dynamic variable derived from TARGET_STATE_GROWTH_PER_YEAR = 100 GiB, all state-creation parameters are re-expressed as multiples of cost_per_state_byte, and two-dimensional metering (regular_gas / state_gas) is introduced with the EIP-7825 transaction cap applying only to the gas dimension; description updated and three authors added.; Classification rationale: Fundamental redesign of the pricing model and introduction of multidimensional metering.; Confidence: high; Commit: e733f8fc7b319ec7c777785431b28127699db236; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e733f8fc7b319ec7c777785431b28127699db236; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e733f8fc7b319ec7c777785431b28127699db236

date: Jan 19, 2026; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-01-19T14:34:53+00:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Splits the parameter table into 'New State Gas' and 'New Regular Gas' columns, assigning explicit accompanying regular-gas charges (e.g. 2,900 for SSTORE; 7,500 for PER_AUTH_BASE_COST derived from EIP-7702's cost analysis).; Classification rationale: Defines new regular-gas cost components alongside the state-gas charges; changes what implementations charge.; Confidence: high; Commit: b0adb33638b54b00a3e69ac983c89f1ce9b19f22; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b0adb33638b54b00a3e69ac983c89f1ce9b19f22; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b0adb33638b54b00a3e69ac983c89f1ce9b19f22

date: Jan 29, 2026; value: 5; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-01-29T18:19:37+08:00; Change type: dependency; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Updates the frontmatter requires header from '2780' to '2780, 7702, 7825, 8011', formalizing dependencies already referenced in the text.; Classification rationale: Changes the declared dependency set, which affects specification interpretation and implementation ordering.; Confidence: high; Commit: ed46fdbb28081b05f0f8535bf5891051999533d5; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ed46fdbb28081b05f0f8535bf5891051999533d5; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ed46fdbb28081b05f0f8535bf5891051999533d5

date: Feb 06, 2026; value: 5; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-02-06T08:54:52+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Fixes a leftover prose value: the stated state-growth target is corrected from 75 GiB to 100 GiB to match the TARGET_STATE_GROWTH_PER_YEAR parameter introduced in e733f8fc.; Classification rationale: Aligns stale prose with the already-normative parameter; no behavior change.; Confidence: high; Commit: 70328117d9a9e8a8fc958270792fac40c435ea1e; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/70328117d9a9e8a8fc958270792fac40c435ea1e; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/70328117d9a9e8a8fc958270792fac40c435ea1e

date: Feb 10, 2026; value: 6; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-02-10T14:46:12+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds CPSB quantization (CPSB_SIGNIFICANT_BITS = 5, CPSB_OFFSET = 9578, stepped bit-truncation formula), the reservoir model for transaction-level gas accounting, bottleneck-resource block accounting, fixed regular-gas values in the table, and a note that regular-gas values will be updated based on EIP-8038.; Classification rationale: Introduces new normative parameters, a new cost formula, and the reservoir accounting model.; Confidence: high; Commit: 2e6dc063300f1c7e893cd0d435168b05c9db8e0b; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2e6dc063300f1c7e893cd0d435168b05c9db8e0b; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2e6dc063300f1c7e893cd0d435168b05c9db8e0b

date: Mar 06, 2026; value: 7; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-03-06T23:59:36+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Clarifies reservoir mechanics: renames refund inputs to tx_gas_used_before_refund, applies the EIP-7623 calldata floor after refunds in tx_gas_used (with receipt semantics), states refund_counter is single and un-dimensioned, and adds the EIP-7702 intrinsic_state_gas adjustment to avoid double counting; removes a leftover TODO marker.; Classification rationale: Materially pins down refund and calldata-floor accounting that implementations must follow.; Confidence: high; Commit: de0ad9db93813d9883302ec1517be668ed195cf3; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/de0ad9db93813d9883302ec1517be668ed195cf3; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/de0ad9db93813d9883302ec1517be668ed195cf3

date: Mar 18, 2026; value: 8; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-03-19T05:51:09+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a single normative rule: when an opcode requires both regular and state gas, the regular gas charge MUST be applied first; an out-of-gas on the regular charge prevents the state gas charge.; Classification rationale: New MUST-level ordering rule affecting gas-accounting implementations.; Confidence: high; Commit: 48566ad265a5c2bb981e520a9b8e17ed9921b8a8; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/48566ad265a5c2bb981e520a9b8e17ed9921b8a8; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/48566ad265a5c2bb981e520a9b8e17ed9921b8a8

date: Mar 20, 2026; value: 9; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-03-20T16:29:54+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Aligns with EIP-7928 gas-validation phases: adds a pre-state/post-state validation section mapping each cost parameter to a validation phase, reservoir-aware pre-state checks, and the SSTORE GAS_CALL_STIPEND rule.; Classification rationale: Specifies how the two-dimensional charges interact with EIP-7928's validation phases; normative for BAL-compatible implementations.; Confidence: high; Commit: 7df0a62ca4255f22a72603595c7a5312649f6e47; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/7df0a62ca4255f22a72603595c7a5312649f6e47; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/7df0a62ca4255f22a72603595c7a5312649f6e47

date: Apr 14, 2026; value: 10; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-04-14T21:07:21+08:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Clarifies that a state-gas charge increments execution_state_gas_used by its full amount regardless of whether it was satisfied from the reservoir, gas_left, or both, and never increments execution_regular_gas_used.; Classification rationale: Resolves a counting ambiguity that directly affects block-level accounting; materially clarifies normative behavior.; Confidence: high; Commit: 2d317791dfadd9f701423fd6c2af60e12a308065; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2d317791dfadd9f701423fd6c2af60e12a308065; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2d317791dfadd9f701423fd6c2af60e12a308065

date: Apr 17, 2026; value: 11; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-04-17T15:23:07+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Changes frame-failure semantics: state gas is now refunded on all frame failures including the top level (restoration via the reservoir), explicitly departing from the earlier rule that account-creation state gas was consumed on revert.; Classification rationale: Reverses previously specified behavior; the diff itself notes the departure from the prior rule.; Confidence: high; Commit: 26d056fe537a6b1393bb6936210384045177fbd6; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/26d056fe537a6b1393bb6936210384045177fbd6; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/26d056fe537a6b1393bb6936210384045177fbd6

date: Apr 17, 2026; value: 12; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-04-17T15:07:26+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: More state-gas accounting changes: separates state-gas and regular-gas refund handling for SSTORE restoration, adds a CREATE-failure state-gas refund for silent failures (balance, nonce, depth, collision), and adds same-transaction SELFDESTRUCT refund rules referencing EIP-6780, including the CALL-with-value-to-selfdestructed-account case.; Classification rationale: Multiple new normative refund rules.; Confidence: high; Commit: 4f0332706351a67eae4adf1bfac880dfb412d237; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4f0332706351a67eae4adf1bfac880dfb412d237; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4f0332706351a67eae4adf1bfac880dfb412d237

path.aria-label: date: Jul 06, 2026; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-07-06T17:03:24Z; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Sync with the Gloas consensus-specs (PR #11859): BUILDER_WITHDRAWAL_PREFIX changes from 0x03 to 0xB0 in all five places it appears; the placeholder predeploy addresses change from 0x...7732/0x...7733 to 0x...01008282/0x...02008282; the placeholder markers on the request-type bytes are dropped; the SSZ containers change base class from object to Container; and the exited-builder top-up rule is tightened so withdrawable_epoch is re-armed only when the exited entry has already swept to zero (withdrawable_epoch != FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH and balance == 0) rather than on every top-up.; Classification rationale: Changes a credential prefix constant, the declared predeploy addresses, an SSZ container declaration and a consensus-layer state-transition condition; all are implementation- and test-visible.; Confidence: high; Commit: 20e77b2b621041e8a82a8d0cec3beb889e589fab; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/20e77b2b621041e8a82a8d0cec3beb889e589fab; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/20e77b2b621041e8a82a8d0cec3beb889e589fab

date: Jul 08, 2026; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-07-08T12:46:18Z; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Fixes the predeploy addresses to values derived from the current reference bytecode (PR #11899): BUILDER_DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS becomes 0x0000bFF46984e3725691FA540a8C7589300D8282 and BUILDER_EXIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS becomes 0x000064D678505ad48F8cCb093BC65613800E8282, both without placeholder markers; the Deployment paragraph is restated to say the addresses derive from the presigned deployment transactions for the current reference bytecode and will change if that bytecode changes.; Classification rationale: Replaces placeholder constants with concrete addresses that implementations and tests must use.; Confidence: high; Commit: 554d3325e31c3f74078402d961355218ece16bee; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/554d3325e31c3f74078402d961355218ece16bee; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/554d3325e31c3f74078402d961355218ece16bee

date: Aug 05, 2026; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-08-05T15:36:19Z; Change type: dependency; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Frontmatter status Draft to Review (PR #12108); removes the parenthetical stating that EIP-7804, a Draft, also claims request type 0x03, leaving only 'The 0x03/0x04 request types MUST be unique across all active EIP-7685 request types; final allocation is coordinated in consensus-specs'; and empties the Reference Implementation TODO comment.; Classification rationale: Removes the EIP's only explicit statement of a request-type-byte conflict with another in-flight proposal, changing its declared cross-EIP reference set; the normative uniqueness requirement itself is retained. Medium confidence because the status move and comment removal alone would be non_substantive and the dropped text was a coordination note rather than a rule.; Confidence: medium; Commit: ba60c6474f603d93abbb4b0520f203dc8cb8c930; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ba60c6474f603d93abbb4b0520f203dc8cb8c930; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ba60c6474f603d93abbb4b0520f203dc8cb8c930

date: Aug 10, 2026; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-08-10T15:23:39Z; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Cleanup and tweaks rewrite (PR #11869, 93 insertions / 72 deletions): adds Felix Lange as an author; replaces Nick's-method presigned deployment with deployment through the EIP-7997 CREATE2 factory using a mined salt; removes the EXCESS_INHIBITOR constant and its deployment-time inhibitor semantics; restructures the request-queue section into Write path / Fee getter / System call and adds that a SYSTEM_ADDRESS call carrying calldata permanently disables the queue via an inhibitor and that non-matching calls MUST revert; states that both contracts apply fee increases per write rather than at end of block, unlike EIP-7002; moves the request-type uniqueness statement below the constants table with a consensus-specs permalink; simplifies the deposit acceptance condition to msg.value >= amount * 1 gwei + fee; fills in Reference Implementation with ethereum/sys-asm links; and condenses Motivation, Rationale, Backwards Compatibility and Security Considerations into headed subsections.; Classification rationale: Changes the deployment mechanism, removes a constant, adds new system-call and revert rules and changes when the fee is updated; all are implementation- and test-visible.; Confidence: high; Commit: 2d3c5e59e47103df15e51aafc815ba0b234e3388; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2d3c5e59e47103df15e51aafc815ba0b234e3388; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2d3c5e59e47103df15e51aafc815ba0b234e3388

Subtitle text 'Primary line: cumulative substantive post-creation revisions. Faint line: all post-creation revisions. Filled inclusion markers are state transitions; open gray markers preserve same-state records. Triangles at panel bottoms are relevant devnets; lower opacity denotes medium-confidence participation. Assessment review lanes from top to bottom: REF, PFI, CFI, SFI, then devnet/testnet markers. Each event type has a fixed lane; the proposal anchor is the amber dashed rule. CUTOFF is the fork-level initial-evaluation horizon; its tooltip identifies whether the EIP is forecastable or late scope.'
